foundation.tagline: Formal mathematics is the foundation of our agentic world.
foundation.headline: An ontology generated through mathematical research.
foundation.thesis: The Group derives its agentic and institutional ontology from mathematical research: marks, claims, witnesses, relations, obligations, actors, transitions, and settlements. Software and operations test these structures and raise new mathematical obligations.
foundation.orientation: These are source dependencies, not borrowed specialties. Each transition needs separate evidence.

stages.name: Relationality
stages.account: Relationality investigates the productive impossibility of absolute relationlessness, treating relations as constitutive rather than additions to assumed independent entities.
stages.limit: The metaphysical argument and proposed formal bridge are distinct from a completed proof.

stages.name: Obsmetrologia
stages.account: The Lean 4 program follows Mark → Utterance → Articulating → Predicating → Positing → Settling, then investigates lawful recoveries of logical, spatial, dynamical, and familiar mathematical structures.
stages.limit: A checked theorem proves its stated result; each metaphysical bridge or mathematical projection needs its own proof.

stages.name: Sign engineering
stages.account: SignCell, SignChain, SignGraph, and SignCraft carry subject–predicate–object cells, evidence, inference, local-to-global structure, and settlement from formal research into software.
stages.limit: Passing software tests does not establish correspondence to a mathematical theorem.

stages.name: Agentic institutions
stages.account: MetroPlat brings these concepts into Actors, Offices, permissions, Work, evidence, and deontic authority, with operations facing real receivers.
stages.limit: Source existence, configured runtime, authorized execution, and customer acceptance require separate receipts.

foundation.feedback: Standards conflicts, counterexamples, operational obstructions, and receiver discrepancies feed back from engineering and operations into mathematical research; agent work improves both.
foundation.frontier: A philosophical claim, Lean-checked theorem, software correspondence, installed operation, and accepted beneficiary outcome each require independent evidence.
